title: Bitcoin mining industry developments and energy usage trends
content:
TL;DR: The Bitcoin network remains robustly operational with a current hashrate of 875.34 EH/s, signaling unwavering commitment to decentralized security. An impending difficulty adjustment, now 67.8% complete with 650 blocks remaining, is projected to decrease, demonstrating the protocol's self-correcting genius in adapting to real-world mining conditions. This algorithmic recalibration reinforces Bitcoin's incorruptible monetary policy, ensuring its role as the hardest money persists against arbitrary fiat manipulation.

The Report

As of February 02, 2026, at 23:10 UTC, the Bitcoin network continues its relentless operation, securing the world's most robust monetary base layer. We observe the current block height at 934,774, a testament to the continuous, immutable ledger being extended every ten minutes on average. The network's computational power, or hashrate, stands at 875.34 Exahashes per second (EH/s).
